newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 7.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Sony Pictures Entertainment has named its Vice President Robert Wynne and Sony Corp of America Vice President Yuki Nozoe to run the studio until United Artists President John Calley makes the move to Sony. Calley's appointment is expected to be announced early this week.
